title: A school trip to the farm
instructions: Öğretmen öğrencilere çiftlik gezisini anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; saatler, kurallar ve gerekenleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: OK, class, listen, please. Tomorrow we are going to Green Hill Farm.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: The bus leaves at half past eight, so please be at school at eight fifteen. Don't be late!

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: The trip takes about forty minutes.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: At the farm, we are going to see cows, sheep, horses and chickens.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: You can feed the sheep, but please do not touch the horses. They are big and they can be dangerous.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: We have lunch at twelve. Bring a sandwich and a drink. Please do not bring sweets.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Wear old clothes and boots, because the farm is very dirty.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: We are coming back to school at three o'clock.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Any questions? No? Good. See you tomorrow!

questions.prompt: What time should students be at school?
questions.feedback: Otobüs sekiz buçukta kalkıyor; öğrenciler sekizi çeyrek geçe okulda olmalı.
questions.evidence: please be at school at eight fifteen.
